input.quote: NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 16.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE AMOUNTS PAYABLE TO THIRD PARTIES UNDER THE INDEMNITIES PROVIDED PURSUANT TO ARTICLE 10, SECTIONS 16.1 AND 16.2 ABOVE; PROVIDED, FURTHER, THAT THE FOREGOING LIMITATION OF LIABILITY SHALL NOT APPLY IN THE CASE OF GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
input.rationale: Section 16.5 (p0727) is a mutual exclusion of special, indirect, punitive, incidental and consequential damages, with carve-outs for the Article 10 / Sections 16.1-16.2 indemnities and for gross negligence and willful misconduct, so the carve-out and mutuality limbs of the fallback are met. However, searches for "aggregate liability", "shall not exceed" and "liability" confirm there is no monetary aggregate cap anywhere in the Agreement (Section 17.3(d) at p0751 only bars the tribunal from awarding punitive or excess damages), so each Party's direct-damages liability is unlimited. The fallback requires a mutual cap of twelve months' fees; the absence of any cap fails that material term, and the exposure is materially adverse to Ono, which carries the commercialization and product-liability indemnity risk for the Ono Territory under Section 16.1. We therefore added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' payments and USD 1,000,000, preserving uncapped treatment for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and confirming Ono's payment obligations are outside the cap.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap with uncapped Excluded Claims to Section 16.5
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 16.5 waives consequential damages but leaves each Party's direct liability entirely uncapped, so we have added a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of twelve (12) months' payments and USD 1,000,000, consistent with our position that liability be capped for both parties at a meaningful amount. Indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and Ono's payment obligations are not limited by it; we can accept a straight twelve-month cap without the USD floor if preferred.

ops.text: Cap on Aggregate Liability. Except in respect of Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the amounts paid or payable by Ono to Array under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) one million U.S. dollars (US$1,000,000). "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article X, its indemnification obligations under Sections 16.1 and 16.2, its gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. Ono's obligation to pay amounts due under Article VI and Article VII shall not constitute damages and shall not be subject to the foregoing cap.
